facts.text: Joey's club prawns: the nightclub where it all falls apart
facts.why: The only nightclub scenes in the sources are the Copacabana, where Joey fights Salvy, and Jake's own Miami club. It is not Joey's club.
facts.fix: Jake's Miami club, where the money and the marriage run out

vibe.verdict: A good fight night program that uses the steak table flip, the belt and the Detroit fights well.
missing: 'I'm da boss' in the dressing room (stand-up night, 1964)
Jake and Joey at the Copacabana (the fight with Salvy)
Vickie at the swimming pool (the Bronx)
The 15th round against Dauthuille with 13 seconds left (the 1950 fight)
Jake pawning the jewels from the belt (the arrest)
The Reeves loss in 1941 (the first loss)
ideas: Swap 'Heckle at your own risk.' for 'I'm da boss.' on Jake's mike line.
Swap the 'Coffee or espresso' footer for 'Table flips cost extra.'
Swap 'Look, don't touch.' on the belt for 'Look, don't pawn.'
Swap 'Stayed on his feet.' for 'The St Valentine's Day one, still standing.' on the 1951 line.
